item.title: UMich quietly ends Biosafety Level 3 lab work
item.description: The University of Michigan no longer operates any Biosafety Level 3 laboratories, following the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s changes to containment guidance for SARS-CoV-2 research in March 2025.
